expected_actions.description: Aliquot 5 uL spore suspension into each of 96 wells
Add 195 uL media overlay into each of 96 wells
Fill inter-well space with media or water to avoid edge effect -- protocol never states which wells or how much, so a correct extraction MUST leave volume/wells ambiguous rather than guess
Cover the plate with a breathable cover
Run plate reader: OD600 every 10 minutes for 48 hours at 37C
